description: This file defines the UserPickerFieldDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of UserPickerField content fields within OrchardCore CMS. It handles rendering views, processing user input, and querying user data.

classes.name: UserPickerFieldDisplayDriver
classes.description: A display driver for UserPickerField that manages rendering and updating user picker fields in OrchardCore.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Generates the display shape for the UserPickerField, showing selected users.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Prepares the edit shape for the UserPickerField, including loading user data for selection.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the UserPickerField, validating input and updating user IDs.
